about: John A. Chanin is an attorney providing legal services covering Business Litigation and Criminal Defense: White Collar.

John Chanin, who practices law in Denver, Colorado, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2012 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Colorado Law School. He graduated in 1991. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1991.
